registration: internal dated protocol; not publicly preregistered
stage: design locked before grid-outcome calculations; numeric solver validation pending
title_zh: 开放充电数据的电量表征差异如何影响配电网电压约束判断：一项可复现的配对敏感性研究
title_en: Sensitivity of distribution-feeder voltage assessments to alternative charging-energy representations in an open EV dataset
primary_question: Under a common feeder, mapping, scaling and background load, how often do the two released energy representations give different hourly voltage-threshold decisions?
secondary_question: Do differences persist after global or zone-wise total-energy matching?

sample.zero_status_mismatch_hours_sensitivity: exclude whole hours flagged in any zone; do not alter source cells

representations.B_global_matched: B * sum(A)/sum(B), sums across all times and zones
representations.B_region_matched: B_z * sum_t(A_z)/sum_t(B_z); all zone totals checked positive

feeders.scope: balanced radial steady-state test feeders; no real Shenzhen grid mapping

main.mapping_rule: numerically sorted TAZIDs round-robin over sorted PQ bus IDs

common_scaling.anchor: Q99 of aggregate A MW over all observed hours, NumPy linear quantile
common_scaling.P0: unscaled nominal active-load sum of each feeder in MW
common_scaling.rule: same c for all four representations; no per-input peak normalization
common_scaling.interpretation: scenario loading ratio, not an EV penetration estimate

background: P_bus=beta*source_P_bus; Q_bus=beta*source_Q_bus; constant over hours, explicitly a controlled benchmark assumption

one_factor_sensitivities.mapping_seed_rule: 20261105+mapping_id; independently permute zones then round-robin to PQ buses; identical mapping for both inputs

primary_metric.name: hourly_voltage_decision_disagreement
primary_metric.definition: mean(violation_A != violation_B); violation if any PQ bus is below 0.95 or above 1.05 p.u.
primary_metric.comparison: A versus B on case33bw under main settings
primary_metric.not: false-positive rate, error against truth, or a measured population risk

secondary_metrics: paired difference in violating-hour fractions (percentage points)
nominal-record max stress and incremental change relative to no-EV background

inference.primary: descriptive paired finite-record comparison, no significance-driven selection
inference.optional_time_resampling: 2000 paired moving-block bootstrap samples of 7 whole days, truncated to 181 days; seed 20261106; resample all zones and both inputs together
inference.scope: temporal resampling within six-month record conditional on synthetic feeder setting; not annual or population confidence

numerical_contract.unit_checks: verify raw kW/ohm conversions exactly once; active graph connected and radial
numerical_contract.required_before_formal_runs: independent backward-forward sweep versus nonlinear AC nodal-equation solution on no-EV and prespecified stress cases
numerical_contract.solver_failure: report separately; never classify failure as safe or physically infeasible automatically
numerical_contract.missing_decision_bounds: if U paired hours unresolved, disagreement lies in [known_disagreements/T,(known_disagreements+U)/T]

excluded_claims: thermal-limit or full hosting-capacity claims without ratings
real road congestion or charging queues
causal effect of the 11-kW rule alone
neutral_reporting: Report absent or disappearing differences after matching; do not add outcome-selected mappings, thresholds, load levels or subgroups.
author_dependent_pending: Whether DOI 10.3390/wevj17030110 is related work by the same authors; matching English names alone do not establish identity.
next_step: Implement and independently verify baseline solvers, then execute the locked main contrasts; no grid-outcome result is included in this package.
